target_gate: One non-homologue accession; target/component taxon concordant; direct D confidence9 B/F assays; primary DOI
taxonomy: Inventory all ChEMBL classification depths; exact inherited accession crosswalk retained. Class nodes are diagnostic functional strata, not biological-family certificates.
sampling_stratum: Fixed second node from root (or only annotated node) for outcome-free coverage balance; no choice of granularity by resulting task yield
target_priority: Within stratum prefer >=128 nominal Ki/Kd molecule IDs and >=2 paper-linked assays, then fixed hash; round-robin strata up to200
assay_priority: Round-robin source DOI buckets by fixed hash; at most20 per target; do not count incomplete support graphs
pooling: Only propose same-target/type/organism and complete matching permitted context signatures. Same target, document or assay_group alone never establishes procedure equivalence.
pool_status: All multi-assay pools pending source/construct concordance; unknown fields/omitted parameters block accepted pooling
construct: Null variant is unknown. No default wild type.
sensitivity: Report single-assay and strict context-signature nominal support separately; unrestricted target/type aggregation is an explicitly noneligible upper bound
roles: Preserve all inherited protected/exposed lineage and task roles. Unknown biological-family mapping is quarantined for final; diagnostic class counts never become certified family counts.
source_review: At most12development documents,24access-metadata/12methods attempts; freeze candidates before source interpretations; retain source availability bias
